title: gtUtils 1.0.0 (July 25, 2026)
text: Coloring: gt_legend_continuous() draws color legend continuously colored column, gradient, steps, blocks. gt_legend_discrete() draws discrete color key categorically colored column. gt_color_ranks() fills cells value columns already hold ranks. gt_row_accent() puts colored bar leading edge row. gt_percentile_bar() draws percentile filled track numbered circular marker tip. gt_highlight_cells() fills individual cells meet condition. gt_highlight_na() styles relabels missing values. gt_group_stripes() shades alternate row groups. gt_outliers() flags values outside IQR fence, number standard deviations, bounds set. Annotations: gt_cutline() draws labeled rule given row. gt_marginalia() styles text column margin notes, wrapping text instead letting stretch table. gt_title_header() builds header optional kicker, subtitle, date. gt_social_tag() puts social handles Font Awesome icons source note. gt_spotlight() highlights rows dimming others. gt_watermark() puts faint wordmark logo behind table body. Formatting: gt_delta() adds computed change column two value columns. gt_significance() adds significance stars p-value column writes matching legend. gt_scale_note() divides columns 1,000 (divisor) adds “Figures thousands.” note match, e.g. gt_fmt_rank() formats numbers ordinals. gt_fmt_tally() merges two count columns one cell can work one share total. Layout: gt_snake() lays long table side--side blocks, column labels. Body-cell styling applied snake carried reshape. gt_snake_align() reshapes parallel frame (precomputed mask, per-cell colors) blocks, grids live outside table’s styles. gt_grid() arranges list separate tables grid, essentially facets tables. gt_theme_preview() renders data every theme package. Saving: gt_social_crop() centers saved table canvas given aspect ratio. gt_save_batch() writes one image per group. Labels: gt_wrap_labels() breaks long column labels across lines instead letting stretch table.
